answer: The fable counter is kept in ocean and plume shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 34 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 34 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1942 identities would post 812 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
